## Quote

`version`, `status` (draft/sent/under-review/won/lost/expired), `supersedes` (linksTo a previous Quote, immutable-history pattern already proven by this realm's Payment/Sole Vault's Payment), `deal` (linksTo Deal), optional `proposal` link, `lineItems` (containsMany the realm's existing `LineItem` FieldDef — reused, not rebuilt). `total` is `computeVia` from the line items.

### Non-goals
Does not itself become an Invoice — that's `convert-quote-to-invoice-command.ts`. Line items are a snapshot of description/qty/price at negotiation time; `Price` cards are the separate catalog entities used to populate them when authoring a quote, not what the line item stores.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at `Quote/acme-enterprise-renewal-q1`, version 1, status `won`, linked to the real `Deal/acme-enterprise-renewal` and `Proposal/acme-enterprise-renewal-proposal` instances, with a real line item matching the deal's $58,000 value.
attributes.cardDescription: A versioned, priced proposal — each negotiation round is a new immutable version, the latest one binding.
